Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to buy a domain?

Yes, but we'll help you get one! Domains cost about €15-20/year. We can register it for you or you can buy your own.

What if I want changes after launch?

Unlimited updates included! Just message us on WhatsApp or email and we'll make the changes.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes! Month-to-month, no long-term contracts. If you're not happy, just let us know.

Do you only work with Irish businesses?

We're based in Ireland and specialize in Irish businesses, but we work with clients worldwide.

What if I need more pages later?

No problem! Additional pages are €29/month each. Most businesses start with 2-3 pages and expand as they grow.
